name: The Cheesecake Manufactory
tagline: A MENU SO LARGE IT HAS PAGE NUMBERS.
address: 1 Cheesecake Concourse, Pavilion Level 2, Outparcel 7, Sunridge Galleria Ring Road, Vestibule Township, CA 91708
about: The Cheesecake Manufactory operates a 412-page menu inside a climate-stabilized Egyptian-revival dining palace. Portions are specified by our structural department and are not adjustable at the table. There is one exit and it is located at the rear of the Cheesecake Vault.

reviews.name: Dwayne T.

reviews.name: Marisol V.
reviews.text: I declined the bread and was billed for the bread. The staff explained the baking had already occurred. I found this reasonable.

reviews.name: Kev
reviews.text: Ordered from page 388. Have not finished it. Have not left.

reviews.name: Prudence O.

reviews.name: R. Halvorsen

items.name: The Original Brown Loaf Service
items.desc: Two molasses-dark loaves and one pale loaf delivered warm on a plank, with a chilled butter medallion of notable mass. The plank remains the property of the Manufactory.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a clean cross-section cutaway through a stacked service of three warm loaves, two nearly black molasses-dark loaves crusted with rolled oats and one pale loaf, sliced flat to expose dense steaming crumb, thick slabs of butter melting down the cut face and pooling on the board beneath. Set on a marble tabletop in a dim palatial dining room, gold-leaf column capitals and hanging amber glass lamps far out of focus behind. Dim amber restaurant lighting, warm golden pools of light, deep mahogany shadows, opulent and slightly oppressive. Camera: 100mm macro, f/5.6, straight-on cross-section view, high micro-contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
